nodes.name: Theorem 3
Theorem 5
Proposition 2.1
nodes.statement:
Fix $d \geq 5$ and $n \geq 4$. There exists $b = b (n) \geq 1$ such that, for any $\delta \in (0,\frac12)$, there exists $\alpha = \alpha (d,n,\delta) > 0$ such that, if $W \in \mathrm{Conf}_{d,n}$ has a clustering $\mathcal{W} \in \mathrm{Clust}_{\alpha,b}^\bullet (W) \cap \mathrm{Ref}^\times$, then 
\begin{equation}
\mathbf{P}_{W} (\xi = \infty) \geq \frac14,
\end{equation}
where $\xi$ is the first time that the natural clustering $(\mathcal{U}_t)_{t \geq 0}$ of $(U_t)_{t \geq 0}$ with $\mathcal{W}$ is not in $\mathrm{Clust}_{g(t),b}^\bullet (U_t)$ where $g(s) = s^{\frac12 - \delta}$ for $s \geq 0$, i.e., 
\[
\xi = \inf \{t \geq 0: \mathcal{U}_t \notin \mathrm{Clust}_{g(t),b}^\bullet (U_t)\}.
\]

nodes.name: Proposition 7.1
nodes.statement:
Fix $d \geq 5$ and $n \geq 4$. Let $b > 0$ and let $\delta \in (0, \frac12 - \frac{1}{d-2})$. For every $\varepsilon \in (0,1)$, there is a constant $\alpha = \alpha (b,d,n,\delta,\epsilon) > 1$ such that, if $a \geq \alpha$, then, for every $\mathcal{C} \in \mathrm{Clust}_{a,b}^\bullet$, 
\[
\mathbf{P}_{\mathcal{C}} \left( (\mathcal{U}_t)_{t \geq 0} \in \mathrm{Grow}_{a,b,\delta} \right) \geq (1 - \varepsilon) \mathbf{Q}_{\mathcal{C}} \left( (\mathcal{V}_t)_{t \geq 0} \in \mathrm{Grow}_{a,b,\delta} \right).
\]

nodes.name: Proposition 9.1
Proposition 9.2
nodes.statement: There is a constant $\alpha = \alpha (b,d,n)$ such that every $\mathcal{C}_0 \in \mathrm{Ref}^\times$ with $\mathrm{sep} (\mathcal{C}_0) \geq \alpha$ satisfies $\mathbf{Q}_{\mathcal{C}_0} (\mathsf{G}) \geq \frac12$.
